grades.quote: The third category is used for TLB refill exceptions.
grades.reason: Places BADV in the general TLB interface category (other than TLB refill exceptions) and TLBRBADV in the category for TLB refill exceptions. This gives the fault-context split but does not say what address each one records.
Describes the TLBRD instruction. It says nothing about BADV or TLBRBADV.
CSR overview table that only lists BADV as 'BAD virtual Address' at 0x7. It has no information on what it stores, and TLBRBADV is not shown.

grades.quote: This register is used to record the bad address when a bad address exception is triggered.
grades.reason: Directly explains that BADV records the bad virtual address on bad-address exceptions (ADEF, ADEM, ALE, BCE, page faults and so on). It also gives the 32-bit mode detail. It does not mention TLBRBADV or how it differs.
